Geographies Served Programs BASKET project Amid the restrictions imposed to curb the spread of the Coronavirus, numerous daily wage earners were deprived of their means of livelihood, leaving their families in distress and struggling to combat hunger. The BASKET initiative aims to provide fresh groceries to these vulnerable families in dire need. The dedicated team at CCM is actively engaged in providing essential supplies and raising awareness about COVID-19, empowering people with knowledge to combat the virus. The team also fosters cleanliness practices, emphasizing habits such as regular handwashing, wearing masks, and maintaining social distance, crucial to staying healthy and preventing the spread of COVID-19. Education support Providing educational support to economically underprivileged children is a crucial step toward fostering a more equitable society. The organisation raises funds to offer scholarships and facilitates access to educational resources to bridge the educational gap. These initiatives not only enhance their learning experiences but also instil confidence and ambition, allowing these children to realize their full potential. Medical support Cancer Control Mission understands the critical need for medical support among child cancer patients and their families. The organisation is dedicated to providing comprehensive medical assistance, including supporting treatment, care, and emotional support, to children battling cancer. Moreover, it prioritizes the emotional well-being of these children and their families by offering counselling, mental health support, and resources to navigate the challenges of paediatric cancer.
